# EvidenceCheck

EvidenceCheck is an evidence-first vendor due-diligence service for procurement, third-party risk, security/compliance teams and AI agents.

## Primary capabilities
- POST /web-extract — clean public webpage extraction; starting at $0.005 USDC
- POST /site-audit — public website security preflight; $0.01 USDC
- POST /vendor-preflight — vendor evidence, gaps and supplier questions; $0.025 USDC
- POST /analyze — business-document analysis
- /review-purchase — fixed-scope human-led vendor review

## Machine interfaces
- https://evidencecheck-api.onrender.com/openapi.json
- https://evidencecheck-api.onrender.com/skill.md
- https://evidencecheck-api.onrender.com/basedagents.json
- https://evidencecheck-site.onrender.com/demo

## Payment
Paid machine endpoints use x402 with USDC on Base mainnet (eip155:8453). Payment is per request; no subscription is required for API calls.

## Trust boundary
Outputs are first-pass evidence and signals. They are not certification, a penetration test, a legal opinion, or proof that a vendor is secure/compliant. Material findings require appropriate human verification.

## Best-fit buyer
Procurement and third-party-risk workflows that repeatedly need to answer: what can we observe publicly, what evidence is missing, and what should we ask the supplier next?

## Commercial intent
The product is designed to reduce repetitive first-pass vendor research and turn missing evidence into concrete next actions. It is intentionally composable: agents can call a narrow endpoint and continue their own workflow with the returned JSON.
